speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I will be Dr. Agent, and I need to understand the specific skin lesion you are concerned about to evaluate for potential oncologic implications. Can you describe the lesion's size, shape, color, and any changes you have noticed over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

The patient's presentation of non-healing, crusted lesions on the penis and finger, combined with his significant smoking history and failed treatment for syphilis and eczema, is highly suspicious for malignancy. I would like to confirm the extent of the disease. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile and digital lesions; REQUEST IMAGES: Clinical photos of the lesions.
